listing.name: Forza Motorsport 2 — Forza Motorsport 2 — Native PC Port (0herculabs)
listing.summary: Upstream describes v0.3.1 as playable and still in development, with race-loading fixes and crash diagnostics. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Forza Motorsport 2 Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. USA/Europe title 4D5307EA; bonus-disc DLC optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the upstream Windows release installer to extract and check your own Europe or USA Forza Motorsport 2 ISO. Its game-code generation process is not confirmed here; follow the project’s setup instructions.

warnings: Upstream describes v0.3.1 as playable and still in development, with race-loading fixes and crash diagnostics.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
